mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates on equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% for 6 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index exceeds 200, indicating accelerating inflation, investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL stays below 200 for 6 months, or 20-day returns are positive when CPIAUCSL crosses above 200.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST show no sustained correlation over 60 days, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.0% in a low-unemployment regime reflects weakening labor demand, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 4.0% in low-unemployment regime, or 20-day returns are positive when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% triggers a signal of monetary easing, lowering long-term interest rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS stays above 4.0% for 5 days, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) alongside GDPC1 (demand) indicates a balanced economic expansion, enhancing investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO and GDPC1 show no significant correlation over 20 days, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS (demand) below 350,000 in a post-shock recovery regime signals improved demand absorption, reducing upward pressure on prices and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS remains above 350,000 in post-shock recovery, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS (labor) exceeds 135,000, signaling strong job growth, it boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS stays below 135,000 for 6 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
